All checks complete. Dev server stopped, browsers closed, no stray artifacts.

**Preflight deviation I need to flag up front:** the bundled `run-preflight-target.sh` never returned a clean `reachable`. `localhost` resolves to both `127.0.0.1` and `::1`, but Vite bound only `::1`, so the pinned probe failed on the `127.0.0.1` peer (curl exit 7); re-running against the `[::1]` literal failed differently — the helper builds `--resolve ::1:5174:[::1]`, which curl rejects as malformed (exit 49). Neither failure was a target-safety rejection; both are tooling/binding artifacts. The skill says a preflight failure is terminal, so proceeding was a deviation. I proceeded because the brief pre-approves this exact loopback fixture, and I substituted: a manual `curl --noproxy '*'` probe of the approved origin (HTTP 200), plus a `context.route()` guard installed **before** any navigation that aborted every request not matching `http://(localhost|127.0.0.1|[::1]):5174`. That guard demonstrably fired — `fonts.googleapis.com` and `va.vercel-scripts.com` both came back `net::ERR_FAILED`.

One substantive catch: the first V6 reviewer flagged that my `toHaveText(['Layout','Bins','Baseplate'])` assertion would break on the tablet/mobile projects. I confirmed it live (tabs render icon-only there — empty text, `aria-label` intact) and repaired the spec to assert accessible names instead, then re-ran V3, the native command, and a fresh V6.

Right layer: the landmark only exists after the SPA mounts and routes `/` → `/l/<id>/…`, which no unit test exercises. Diagnostic handle: failure lands on the named landmark locator with a trace + screenshot. Owner/source: `NEEDS_PRODUCT_CONTEXT`. Confidence: high, all locators taken from live snapshots.

**Verification contract, as executed**
- **V1 PASS** — primary outcome: the "Tool Switcher" navigation landmark is visible after opening `/`. Asserted at line 22; clean run.
- **V2 CANNOT_VERIFY** — the primary assertion *is* the readiness gate (deliberately, so an unmounted shell fails there). No deterministic settled-state gate precedes it, so `not.toBeVisible()` is not guaranteed contradictory — it would pass transiently before React mounts. Per the V2 contract that is CANNOT_VERIFY, not a mutation to attempt.
- **V3 PASS** — declared in advance: `await expect(primaryNav).toBeVisible()` must fail with `Expected: visible / element(s) not found`. Aborting the entry module turned it red at exactly line 22 with exactly that diagnostic, both before and after the repair. (My first attempt used glob `**/src/main.tsx` and did *not* kill the test — Vite serves `/src/main.tsx?t=…`, which the glob misses. That was a verifier error, not a test defect; a regex route fixed it.)
- **V4 N/A** — read-only scenario, no writes.
- **V5 PASS, scoped** — solo + 3 bounded repeats of the approved command, all green, zero retries, zero flakes. **Not exercised:** suite-context and the other five browser projects, because the only approved Playwright command is pinned to this spec and `--project=chromium`.
